# WTI front-month (CL=F) close on 2026-10-05: research notes as of 2026-09-07

Note: Most result pages would not load (the proxy refused them), so many figures below come from search-result snippets. I have left out every result dated after 2026-09-07.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Yahoo Finance CL=F daily close for 2026-10-05, which is a Monday and a normal trading day. I tried to fetch the Yahoo history page and the connection was refused, so I could not read the latest value from it directly.
- Contract roll: the October 2026 contract (CLV26) should stop trading around Sept 22, so on Oct 5 CL=F should track the November 2026 contract (CLX26). The September contract expired 2026-08-20. [Barchart CLU26](https://www.barchart.com/futures/quotes/CLU26)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. WTI is trading in the low $90s.
- 2026-09-07 (Labor Day, US floor closed, electronic trading open): WTI rose 1.8% to $93.10 and Brent rose 1.5% to $97.73, a six-week high. This followed reports that Saudi Aramco facilities were hit and that Iran and the US were trading strikes. That implies a 2026-09-04 settle of about $91.4, which fits Robinhood's Sept 4 market, where the $91-91.99 bracket was priced at 98¢. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/07/oil-prices-rise-to-6-week-high-after-iran-and-us-trade-blows-saudi-aramco-facilities-reportedly-hit.html), [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/financial/events/oil-price-wti-on-sep-4-2026-sep-04-2026-10875db2/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-07: Brent is up about 9% over five days to around $97 as US-Iran strikes intensify in the Strait of Hormuz. Kpler counts about 10 commodity ships a day crossing the strait. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/9/7/oil-prices-surge-as-us-iran-strikes-intensify-in-strait-of-hormuz)
- 2026-09-06: OPEC+ (seven members) kept October quotas unchanged, ending a run of four straight monthly hikes. The next meeting is set for Oct 4. The UAE left OPEC in May. [Nairametrics](https://nairametrics.com/2026/09/06/opec-pauses-oil-output-hikes-after-four-straight-monthly-increases/), [Gulf News](https://gulfnews.com/business/energy/opec-keeps-october-oil-output-quota-unchanged-from-september-levels-1.500665366)
- 2026-09-04: Brent was $96.90 at 9am ET, down $2.48 from the day before. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-oil-09-04-2026/)
- 2026-09-03: Brent was $99.38 at 8am ET. A year earlier it was $67.85. [Yahoo/Fortune](https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/current-price-oil-september-3-120000525.html)
- 2026-08-28: WTI fell about 4% on the week and Brent more than 5%, as US-Iran talks stalled. EIA Cushing spot weekly average: $84.57, down from $87.21. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/28/oil-on-track-for-weekly-loss-even-as-iran-tensions-simmer.html), [EIA WPSR](https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/pdf/highlights.pdf)
- 2026-08-10/12: Prices swung on uncertainty over a US-Iran deal on Hormuz and on new attacks. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/10/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz-trump-iran.html), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/8/12/oil-prices-rise-as-attacks-dent-hopes-for-strait-of-hormuz-reopening)
- 2026-07-08: Oil jumped after US strikes on Iran, reversing a slide back to pre-war levels. WTI had briefly dropped below $70 in July. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/8/oil-prices-surge-as-us-strikes-iran-reversing-fall-to-pre-war-levels)

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- 2026 range: WTI's settlement high was about $112.95 on April 7, with intraday prints near $117-119 in March and April. It first settled above $100 on 2026-03-30. The low was briefly under $70 in early July. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-03-30/us-crude-oil-settles-above-100-for-first-time-since-2022), [search summary of Wikipedia chronology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E2%80%932028_world_oil_market_chronology)
- Week-to-week moves of 4-9% have been common since July (late August -4%, first week of September roughly +9% for Brent). Monthly swings of $10-20 happened several times in 2026, for example the slide from about $100+ to under $70 into July. That is far more volatile than the usual 1-month WTI standard deviation of about 8-10% in calmer years. Even at that calmer pace, about $91-93 implies a one-sigma band of roughly ±$8-9 over four weeks. In this war regime the realized band looks wider. This is my own calculation, not from a source.
- Trend: prices rose from the late-August low (Cushing spot about $84.6) to about $93 on Sept 7.

## 5. Other forecasts
- EIA STEO, August 2026: WTI averages $80.88 for 2026 (up from $76.26) and $65.39 for 2027. It assumed severe Hormuz restrictions lasting until August, with prices easing in early 2027. [Investinglive](https://investinglive.com/news/eia-raises-crude-oil-price-forecasts-as-middle-east-supply-risks-tighten-outlook/), [EIA PDF](https://www.eia.gov/outlooks/steo/archives/aug26.pdf)
- Polymarket has a "What will WTI hit in September 2026" market, and Kalshi has hourly WTI markets. I could not load current odds dated on or before Sept 7. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/what-price-will-wti-hit-in-september-2026), [Lines.com week of Sept 7](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/finance/will-wti-hit-week-of-september-7-2026)
- Kalshi traders earlier priced a year-end WTI max above $125. That article is undated in my results. [Hellenic Shipping News](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/u-s-oil-prices-will-exceed-iran-wartime-high-to-above-125-as-conflict-drags-on-kalshi-traders-say/)
- I could not find a sell-side consensus target for early October that was dated on or before Sept 7.

## 6. Upcoming events before Oct 5
- US-Iran fighting and the status of Hormuz shipping, including any corridor deal or memorandum of understanding. This is the main swing factor.
- Attacks on Saudi or Gulf energy infrastructure.
- Weekly EIA inventory reports (Wednesdays) and the EIA September STEO (around Sept 9).
- IEA and OPEC monthly oil reports (mid-September).
- Fed FOMC meeting (mid-September).
- October contract expiry around Sept 22, after which CL=F rolls to November. Watch the Oct-Nov spread: in a backwardated market the roll lowers the quoted front-month price.
- OPEC+ meeting on Oct 4, one day before resolution. It is expected to focus on a capacity review for 2027 quotas.
